relationships.subject: GPR55
relationships.evidence_quote: Together, these data suggest that GPR55 has a significant, if not dominant, role in mediating these anti-inflammatory actions produced by KLS-13019.

relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD was found to be effective in producing a significant effect on all inflammatory assays; however, the mean efficacy for all the assays was only 25 ± 2% of their respective controls.

key_findings: GPR55 siRNA knockdown (~59% neuritic) attenuated KLS-13019 anti-inflammatory efficacy by ~56% in paclitaxel-treated DRG cultures.
CBD had ~4-fold lower efficacy than KLS-13019 and was poorly attenuated by GPR55 siRNA.
